name: Global Cloud Cover with Curl Noise
definition: Generating global cloud patterns by adding octaves of mixed Perlin and Worley noise, subtracting a threshold, and clamping to create 2D patterns on a spherical surface, restricted between bottom and top heights.
summary: Global Cloud Cover with Curl Noise generates spherical cloud patterns using mixed Perlin and Worley noise, distinguishing itself through efficient global coverage and high-frequency detail.
